what: A test Subject staged in real time for the late-correction case. Revision 1 is in force from 2026-11-25. Revision 2 (with source_revision) is to be issued only after an agent-side record referencing revision 1 has been anchored by its operator, so that the anchor is earlier than the correction in fact and not by construction.

claim.source_document: FHA Single Family Loan Performance Trends (Credit Risk Report)
